t: This is the site of the Trew Era Cafe in Hoxton, Hackney. It was a non-profit coffeehouse, opened in March 2015 by the comedian and activist Russell Brand. It was funded by the profits from his 2014 book, Revolution. Brand is an English comedian, actor and podcaster, who first rose to prominence as a stand-up and as the host of Big Brother's Big Mouth on E4.
